verdict.rationale: Unity documents an official MCP server (com.unity.ai.assistant package) that connects Claude Code, Cursor, and other LLM agents to the Unity Editor via standardized MCP tools, and newer runtime evidence shows this has evolved into a first-party CLI 'unity mcp' server mode, both explicitly first-party and fully supported. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the new CLI's MCP mode (only the third-party community MCP has large-scale adoption evidence), and the official server has closed distribution (no public repo) unlike the community alternative.
